$description: Popover (platform/components/Popover, library wave 5, lane A): its component tokens. The surface is the menu's: the overlay surface, the default border, the menu radius and the menu shadow.

popover-background.$description: Popover: the surface (the overlay surface, as Menu).

popover-focus-border-color.$description: Popover: the border while the popover itself has keyboard focus (no controls inside); only the border color changes.

popover-padding.$description: Popover: the padding inside the border, on every side.

popover-sm-width.$description: Popover size sm: 240px wide (a hover card, a short explanation).

popover-lg-width.$description: Popover size lg: 400px wide (a short form, a teaching bubble with a picture).

popover-max-width.$description: Popover: never wider than the window less its margins.

popover-header-gap.$description: Popover: the gap between the title and Close.

popover-header-margin-block-end.$description: Popover: the space under the header.

popover-header-min-height.$description: Popover: the header is at least as tall as its Close button (the inline-action role).

popover-footer-gap.$description: Popover: the gap between the footer's actions.

popover-footer-margin-block-start.$description: Popover: the space above the footer.

popover-arrow-size.$description: Popover arrow: its height (half its base).

popover-arrow-border-color.$description: Popover arrow: its outline, the popover's border color.

popover-arrow-fill.$description: Popover arrow: its fill, the popover's surface.

popover-arrow-outset.$description: Popover arrow: its base on the outer edge of the border.

popover-arrow-fill-offset.$description: Popover arrow: the fill one border width in, so the border runs round the arrow.

popover-arrow-fill-center.$description: Popover arrow: the fill centered on the outline (minus the arrow size).

popover-arrow-inset.$description: Popover arrow: its distance from the corner in an aligned placement (start, end, top, bottom).

popover-arrow-middle.$description: Popover arrow: centered on the edge in a centered placement.

popover-hover-open-delay.$description: Hover card: how long the pointer rests on the trigger before it opens.

popover-hover-close-delay.$description: Hover card: how long it stays after the pointer leaves, so the pointer can move into it.
